scene_analysis.scene_overview: A sunny day in a city with a large building in the background and several motorcycles parked along the sidewalk in front of it. The street is busy with cars and buses passing by. There are also some trees and flower pots with plants in them. The sky is blue with some white clouds.
scene_analysis.buildings: The building has a tall rectangular shape with many windows and a flat roof. It is made of brown stone and has a few balconies. There are two other buildings in the background, one with a similar style but smaller. The ground floor of the main building has a black metal railing around it.
scene_analysis.materials: The building's facade is made of brown stone with a smooth texture. The windows have a dark tinted glass. The balconies are small and have metal railings.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and trash cans along the sidewalk. Some of the benches are made of wood and others are metal.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are several trees planted in large planters along the sidewalk. They have green leaves and red flowers.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs posted along the street, including a red sign with a white arrow pointing down and a blue sign with white text.
scene_analysis.pedestrian_activity: There are several people walking along the sidewalk, some carrying bags or backpacks.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The street is bustling with activity as people go about their daily business.
scene_analysis.as_commuter: The street is a convenient location for commuting to work or school.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: The street is a great place to take photos and enjoy the sights and sounds of the city.
scene_analysis.as_student: The street is a great place to study or relax.
